parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: The lens is a cylindrical optical component made of glass, located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the camera sensor or film to form an image.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for focusing or zooming depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button (Shutter Button)
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the top of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed to capture a photo by triggering the shutter mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button (Mode Button)
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located near the top or side of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to change camera modes or settings such as flash, timer, or exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Button (Power Button)
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button typically located on the top or side of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It turns the camera on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and may toggle between on and off states.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the camera made of durable plastic, housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for the internal electronics and optics.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components together.
